localization_definitions.ranking: retained chunk order, deduplicated by first occurrence of relative_path
localization_definitions.recall: unique Gold files in first K deduplicated files / all frozen Gold files
localization_definitions.mrr: reciprocal first relevant file rank; zero only for a fully resolved no-match list
localization_definitions.depth: retained initial retrieval only, not an exhaustive repository ranking
localization_definitions.unresolved: unresolved chunk stops certified prefix; non-identifiable metrics are null
localization_definitions.single_shot: selected rendered Hybrid context, not a fresh raw retrieval ranking
localization_definitions.mini: no precomputed retrieval: initial localization is not applicable, not zero
localization_definitions.tool_step: one-based position in all completed tool results; first successful nonempty read_file/search_code response for a Gold file, excluding initial context
localization_definitions.time: read/search completion timestamps are not retained: elapsed_ms is unavailable
localization_definitions.aggregate: macro mean over available task metrics; each denominator is explicit

localization_aggregation_warning: Available-only means with n<8 are diagnostic subsets, not full-arm comparative scores.
initial_timing_scope: Indexing timer includes ingest, chunking, BM25 construction and/or cached embedding lookup and vector indexing. Retrieval timer covers the initial query. These retained runtime timers exclude earlier GPU cache construction; not cold embedding benchmarks.
limitations: 8 previously inspected issues, one repetition per arm; 40 slots are not 40 independent issues.
Post-debug seen-task rerun, not fresh blind holdout or the official full SWE-bench score.
Single-shot uses the first actually rendered Hybrid context, but its diff-format instruction is weaker. Interaction, compute, and output-contract differences confound causal attribution.
The 75% versus 12.5% comparison is descriptive, not a clean architecture-only uplift claim.
Historical unknown-cost reserves remain reserved; estimates exclude cloud charges and are not a reconciled provider invoice.
No new paid experiment, patch repair, sandbox test, indexing, or embedding is run by this report.
Safety telemetry is not an adversarial security evaluation or proof of no secret exposure.
